info.name: Audit Logs API
info.description: Retrieve a log of actions taken in your Circle account.

item.name: Get an audit log by ID

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the audit log entry.

request.description: Returns a single audit log entry by its unique identifier.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of audit log entries for your account, ordered from newest to oldest. Use the query parameters to filter by time range, event type, actor, or outcome.
Results are paginated using opaque cursors returned in the `Link` response header.

response.name: Successfully retrieved a list of audit logs.
